A simple yet exquisite dish made by grilling high-quality meat on top of rock salt.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== [[Link]] can make Salt-Grilled Prime Meats by [[Cooking]] either [[Raw Prime Meat]] or a [[Raw Bird Thigh]] with [[Rock Salt]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. He can eat these [[Meal]]s to restore some [[Heart]]s. These dishes are known to be simple yet exquisite, due to their use of high-quality [[Meat]]. By adding extra ingredients, Link can create the following variations of Salt-Grilled Prime Meat: * '''Hearty Salt-Grilled Prime Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Salt-Grilled Prime Meat}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
A simple yet exquisite dish made by grilling high-quality meat on top of rock salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty ingredients. When eaten, they'll heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him temporary Hearts. * '''Energizing Salt-Grilled Prime Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Salt-Grilled Prime Meat}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
A simple yet exquisite dish made by grilling high-quality meat on top of rock salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing ingredients. These meals will restore part of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] if they're eaten. * '''Enduring Salt-Grilled Prime Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Salt-Grilled Prime Meat}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
A simple yet exquisite dish made by grilling high-quality meat on top of rock salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring ingredients. Link's Stamina Wheel will be completely restored and overfilled when he eats these. * '''Hasty Salt-Grilled Prime Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Salt-Grilled Prime Meat}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
A simple yet exquisite dish made by grilling high-quality meat on top of rock salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty ingredients. By eating these meats, Link's movement speed will be increased. * '''Spicy Salt-Grilled Prime Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Salt-Grilled Prime Meat}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
A simple yet exquisite dish made by grilling high-quality meat on top of rock salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy ingredients. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Electro Salt-Grilled Prime Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Salt-Grilled Prime Meat}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
A simple yet exquisite dish made by grilling high-quality meat on top of rock salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric ingredients. They can be eaten for Link to gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Mighty Salt-Grilled Prime Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Salt-Grilled Prime Meat}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
A simple yet exquisite dish made by grilling high-quality meat on top of rock salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty ingredients. When eaten, they will provide a boost to Link's attack power. * '''Tough Salt-Grilled Prime Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Salt-Grilled Prime Meat}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
A simple yet exquisite dish made by grilling high-quality meat on top of rock salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough ingredients. These meats will grant Link a boost to his defensive abilities when eaten. * '''Sneaky Salt-Grilled Prime Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Salt-Grilled Prime Meat}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
A simple yet exquisite dish made by grilling high-quality meat on top of rock salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky ingredients. Link will receive a boost to his [[Stealth]] abilities when he eats these. * '''Chilly Salt-Grilled Prime Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Salt-Grilled Prime Meat}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
A simple yet exquisite dish made by grilling high-quality meat on top of rock salt.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly ingredients. By eating them, Link will gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Salt-Grilled Prime Meat can be made by [[Cooking]] a piece of [[Rock Salt]] with either [[Raw Prime Meat]] or a [[Raw Bird Thigh]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Salt-Grilled Gourmet Meat * Salt-Grilled Meat }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Salt-Grilled Food |items= BotW, TotK }}
